children: Madrid, September 16, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has today affirmed Unicaja Banco, S.A.' s deposit ratings at A3/Prime-2 and has changed the outlook on the long-term deposit ratings to positive from stable. We have also affirmed: the bank's Baseline Credit Assessment and Adjusted BCA at baa2; the bank's subordinated debt rating at Baa3; the Counterparty Risk Assessments at A2/ Prime-1; and the Counterparty Risk Ratings at A2/Prime-1. --RATIONALE FOR AFFIRMING THE BCA.

title: Moody's Ratings affirms Unicaja's A3 deposit rating, outlook changed to positive
